result.title: From Classifier Heads to Encoder Prototypes: Personalized Federated Learning with Head-Derived Clustering
result.summary: Personalized federated learning must decide which clients should share representations. We introduce HDC-FL (Head-Derived Clustering for Personalized Federated Learning), which reads that decision off a signal shared-encoder training already produces: the client-specific classifi- er heads. At periodic refresh rounds the server projects the cached heads into a normalized low-rank descriptor space, groups the descriptors, builds one encoder prototype per group from the cached client encoders, and returns to each client a soft mixture of those prototypes paired with its own unchanged head. Client-specific heads are never averaged or distributed to oth- er clients; the shared-encoder trajectory is left intact; and no second optimization trajectory, additional local objective, or post-training fine-tuning stage is required. Across 11 CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 configurations covering label-subset, Dirichlet and rotation heterogeneity with ResNet-18 and MobileNetV2 encoders, HDC-FL is competitive with the strongest personalized and clustered baselines in macro-averaged mean accuracy and attains the numerically highest macro-averaged worst-client and bottom-20% accuracy among the evaluated methods. The tail results distinguish methods that look similar when only their means are compared. A controlled donor-swap diagnostic further finds positive donor-ranking associations between head similarity and encoder compatibility in all three settings tested, most clearly under covariate shift.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HDC-FL：在个性化联邦学习中，利用共享编码器训练时已产生的各客户端分类头作为信号，将缓存头投影到归一化低秩描述空间后聚类，按组构建编码器原型并以软混合方式回传，同时保留各客户端原有分类头；在 CIFAR-10/100 多配置上比较均值与尾部客户端精度，并用 donor-swap 诊断检验头相似性与编码器兼容性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其「从训练中已有的内部信号（分类头）判别表示兼容性」及受控 donor-swap 交换诊断，可能为核查 latent 相似度是否真反映功能性兼容、以及免额外训练地从内部状态读取信息提供评价思路，需较多迁移核查。
